cold: New isolated browser process and context for every observation; OS cache is not reset.
warm: One unmeasured priming navigation of the same version in a new context, then two measured reloads. No cross-version priming.
cache: Browser HTTP cache enabled in every run; preserve and report actual response statuses and fromDiskCache. PMTiles localhost transport keeps its existing no-store policy.
foreground: Page.bringToFront and ten regular requestAnimationFrame callbacks in about:blank before every cold navigation; focus and visibility recorded every50ms and on transitions in the measured document.
primary_metric: navigation-to-first MapLibre idle where selector has343paths, map.loaded=true, areTilesLoaded=true, isMoving=false; compare only if final camera and style/layer identity checks pass.
invalid_focus_rule: Record but exclude when document is hidden after DOMContentLoaded, any milestone is unfocused/hidden, or focus remains false for>100ms after DOMContentLoaded. Never exclude based on duration alone.
timeout_rule: No useful map by30s is an observed failure, not a slow-run exclusion; retain evidence and fail acceptance.
failure_rule: Missing assets, mismatched camera/style/layers, map errors or selector count failures block closure; do not change thresholds after reading results.
scope_limit: Controlled local fixture with equal750x558map area, not mobile or production percentiles;10%is an operational threshold, not statistical significance or global optimality.
browser_mode: Explicit --headed false; HeadlessChrome userAgent confirmed and Browser.getVersion stored per observation; no focus emulation.
